lines.en: label dojogen2:
scene ayanenoongen2
I wind up in the dojo and spend the afternoon watching Ayane spar with various other...karate people. Or whatever they're called.
lines.zh: 我最后还是来了道场，花了一下午看 Ayane 和形形色色的……空手道人士对打。管他们叫什么吧。

lines.en: It's become pretty evident by now that I have no real intention of improving my ability, but Ayane has seemed more determined than ever lately.
lines.zh: 现在相当明显了，我根本没什么提升自己的打算，倒是 Ayane 最近看起来比以往都要认真。

lines.en: if bonus == True:
I worry that she might be drifting out of her seemingly endless honeymoon-phase with me but, in some way, this feels like a little more than that.
lines.zh: 我有点担心她是不是正从我俩那段看似没有尽头的蜜月期里走出来，不过从某种角度看，这件事的含义又不只是这样。

lines.en: It's like she's becoming so comfortable with the bond between us that just being around me is enough to validate her feelings.
lines.zh: 就好像她对我们之间的羁绊已经安心到，只要待在我身边，就足以确认自己的感情。

lines.en: It's cute. So cute that I can't help cheering her on as she tries to take down her sparring partners.
lines.zh: 很可爱。可爱到她每次试图放倒对手时，我都忍不住为她加油。

lines.en: scene black
if secondbeach18 == True and christmastwo20 == False:
Ayane wins every single match she takes place in and, riding a high of confidence, challenges {s}the karate instructor{/s} NO ONE. OSAKO IS NOT HERE RIGHT NOW. AYANE FIGHTS ALONE.
lines.zh: Ayane 参加的每一场都赢了，趁着自信爆棚，她向{s}空手道教练{/s}「无」发起挑战。OSAKO 现在不在。AYANE 独自应战。

lines.en: Of course, she is then promptly annihilated and spends the next ten minutes convincing me to give her a massage.
lines.zh: 当然，她随即被干脆利落地击败，接下来的十分钟都在说服我给她按摩。

lines.en: I agree but, the second I attempt to do so, the {s}instructor{/s} NO ONE asks us to either focus up or leave.
lines.zh: 我答应了，可我刚要动手，{s}教练{/s}「无」就要求我们要么专心训练，要么出去。

lines.en: else:
Ayane wins every single match she takes place in and, riding a high of confidence, challenges the karate instructor.
lines.zh: Ayane 参加的每一场都赢了，趁着自信爆棚，她向空手道教练发起挑战。

lines.en: Of course, she is then promptly annihilated and spends the next ten minutes convincing me to give her a massage.
lines.zh: 当然，她随即被干脆利落地击败，接下来的十分钟都在说服我给她按摩。

lines.en: I agree but, the second I attempt to do so, the instructor asks us to either focus up or leave.
lines.zh: 我答应了，可我刚要动手，教练就要求我们要么专心训练，要么出去。

lines.en: Ayane focuses up.
I leave.
